studies.label: Lab experiment: product improvement with assigned ChatGPT access, followed by unassisted product invention

counts_source.locator: PDF p. 8, Method, Participants and Design (two excerpts); analyzed arm counts repeated in Table 4 on PDF p. 20
counts_source.quote: Outcomes reported below are based on data from 196 participants; [...] Participants were randomly assigned to one of three learning groups: human-only (control condition; n = 64), general-AI (n = 67), or regulated-AI (n = 65).

arms.name: human-only
arms.description: Completed the product improvement task independently with no other browser tabs or windows open; then completed the invention task without AI (PDF pp. 13-14; Appendix A).

arms.name: general-AI
arms.description: Freely used ChatGPT-4 throughout the 12-minute product improvement task in a split-screen interface; then completed the invention task without ChatGPT (PDF p. 14; Appendix A).

arms.name: regulated-AI
arms.description: Think first, ChatGPT later: generated initial ideas independently for 3 minutes, worked with ChatGPT-4 for 6 minutes with sample prompts encouraging collaborative improvement, development, and evaluation, then independently refined and submitted the best idea for 3 minutes. The subsequent invention task had no AI or sample prompts (PDF p. 14; Appendix A, PDF pp. 34-35).

studies.task: Propose one original and useful improvement to a stuffed bunny, then independently invent and develop a foreign-language vocabulary game for adults and university students (PDF pp. 9, 11-12, and 14; Appendices A-B).

ai_tool.name: ChatGPT-4 (GPT-4 version of ChatGPT via the web interface and a ChatGPT Plus subscription)
ai_tool.locator: PDF pp. 13-14, Procedure; PDF p. 42, Reproducibility Note. Default parameters, with memory/model training switched off; release year not stated.

preregistration.where: No preregistration mentioned in the full document. The OSF link in Data Availability (PDF p. 41) is for data and analysis code.

estimates.outcome: Originality of the product improvement solution
estimates.question: with_ai
estimates.measure_detail: Originality (uniqueness) of the submitted idea, rated from 1 (not original/useful/elaborate at all) to 7 (extremely original/useful/elaborate) by two trained, experienced experts blind to condition using the Consensual Assessment Technique. Raters viewed responses in randomized order and judged them relative to the pool; their two scores were averaged for each participant (PDF pp. 15-16).

open_items: Counts at randomization and the excluded participant's arm are not printed. The paper reports participation before exclusion and analyzed totals/arm counts; n_randomized remains null (PDF p. 8).

The SD used to standardize the printed d values is not specified. Pairwise raw differences, numerical SEs, and confidence intervals are not printed in the main pairwise results; none were derived (PDF pp. 20-22).

Figure 2 provides graphical SE bars only. Additional total-effect regression coefficients and intervals in Fig. 3 are image-only and were not transcribed under the extraction rule (PDF pp. 21 and 26).

Whether ChatGPT remained accessible during the regulated-AI arm's independent final refinement phase is not stated. The improvement task remains classified with_ai in line with the paper and reconciled form (PDF pp. 9, 14, and 35).

Randomization method and whether each lab session mixed conditions are not stated. The paper describes individual assignment and lab sessions of up to five; session allocation/clustering cannot be confirmed (PDF pp. 8 and 12-13).

Possible sample overlap with the Qiu 2025 thesis is an unverified lead from the search/citation records. The article does not identify the thesis and the screening form identifies no confirmed shared sample.
The paper does not state the release year or dated snapshot of GPT-4 used. ai_tool.year is null (PDF p. 42).
notes: Independent extraction B, 2026-10-10. Read the full markdown conversion including all appendices and references, inspected the PDF tables and figures, and checked all extracted numerical values against PDF text using PyMuPDF. PDF and printed page numbers agree. Quotes preserve source wording and printed numeric precision, with layout whitespace and soft line-break hyphenation normalized; the study count quote marks omitted text with [...]. Numeric decimal places are retained in the JSON. The single experiment randomized groups between participants. Repeated outcomes on different fixed-order tasks do not make these contrasts randomized-order within-person comparisons. The analysis uses one averaged expert score per participant on each task; SD level and uncertainty basis are participant. The omnibus interaction F statistics are deliberately not assigned to pairwise comparisons. The same participants contribute both tasks and the three pairwise comparisons share arms. No across_people measure, combined-AI versus control contrast, or overall-creativity composite is reported. The paper calls originality, usefulness, and elaboration primary outcomes, but preregistration is not stated. Under the codebook selection rule, general-AI versus human-only originality is the candidate primary comparison for both with_ai and after_ai. The regulated protocol bundles guidance and time structure with AI access, and the absent regulated-human arm is an acknowledged limitation (PDF pp. 14, 29, and 32). The OSF data/code deposit is mentioned on PDF p. 41; no statistics were computed from deposited data. The PDF is the numerical source of record.
